prompts.layout:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create a NEW landscape 3:2 Chinese educational infographic for a detailed AOM double-pass blog. Reference image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: adopt its attractive glass optics, clear laser rays, compact illustrated explanations, crisp navy Chinese typography, colored section bands, white background. Do NOT copy its three-column subject or its fringe diagnostics. Make one focused beautiful illustrated optical bench diagram titled exactly "AOM 双程光路". Premium textbook illustration: translucent pale blue PBS cube with diagonal internal interface, blue crystal AOM with subtle acoustic grating, thin purple quarter-wave plate, curved glass positive lens, silver flat end mirror, small elegant optical mounts and faint shadows. Use orthographic side-view so rays are unambiguous, not arbitrary 3D connections.
GEOMETRY: left-to-right laser input → PBS → AOM on horizontal zero-order axis → QWP → positive lens → flat end mirror. The FIRST ORDER leaves the AOM angled slightly UP, crosses QWP and upper lens area, and becomes HORIZONTAL between lens and mirror. Lens optical center stays on horizontal ZERO-ORDER axis. End mirror is VERTICAL, normal to the first-order post-lens ray. Grey dotted zero-order beam continues horizontally through lens center and ends at a BLACK BEAM STOP before the mirror. Orange dashed RETURN retraces first-order path from mirror through lens and QWP back to AOM, then after SECOND diffraction returns horizontally left along original input axis to PBS, where it turns downward into output. Offset outgoing/return rays slightly ONLY for legibility, make all direction arrowheads correct (outbound right, return left, output down). No additional optics or extra beams. Draw a small RF driver below AOM connected to the crystal.
Labels in Chinese, short and widely spaced: "输入光 ν₀", "PBS", "AOM", "QWP", "透镜", "反射镜", "零级光 → 光束挡", "RF 驱动", "输出 ν₀ + 2fRF". Blue solid outbound, orange dashed return. Above return arm label "第一程：+fRF"; on lower side after second diffraction label "第二程：+fRF". Fine dimension arrows beneath AOM-to-lens and lens-to-mirror labeled "≈ fL" each. Top small subtitle "两次衍射 · 频移叠加 · 指向补偿". Bottom two refined short note cards, exact text: "猫眼：透镜 + 反射镜" and "QWP 往返使线偏振转过 90°". Small footnote: "示意图不按比例；需确认 AOM 的偏振兼容性". Avoid paragraphs, avoid glare over text, avoid decorative clutter, correct coherent optical geometry above all. Large usable diagram filling canvas with generous labeling room, publication quality Chinese text.

prompts.frequency:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create a NEW landscape 3:2 illustrated Chinese infographic explaining frequency accumulation in an AOM double-pass. Input image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, use its premium textbook style: translucent blue crystal optics on little mounts, white background, refined pale blue and warm orange section cards, large navy Chinese labels, crisp arrows. Title exactly "两次衍射，频移逐次相加". Subtitle "传播方向反转，不代表频移反号".
Two horizontal roomy illustrated story strips. TOP blue strip "升频双程": show three stages linked by arrows left to right: "输入光" with small laser and label "ν₀"; "第一次衍射" with a blue AOM crystal and label "ν₀ + fRF"; "第二次衍射" with second appearance of same AOM crystal and label "ν₀ + 2fRF". Place +fRF over each of the two arrows. A tiny curved mirror icon between the two AOM stages labeled "反射返回" suggests double traversal of the same crystal. These are chronological stages, not two physical AOMs on an optical bench. BELOW orange strip "降频双程": same three stages with "ν₀", "ν₀ − fRF", "ν₀ − 2fRF", arrows annotated −fRF. Each strip visually rich but uncluttered. Bottom two inset cards: left "RF = 80 MHz" then clear large "双程频移 = ±160 MHz"; right "两次同号衍射" and below "总频移 = ±2fRF". Small clear footnote "时间顺序示意：两个 AOM 图标代表同一晶体的两次作用". Ensure exact plus/minus values, no sine plots or invented data, no extra equations. Scientific diagram, NOT a marketing poster; prioritize precise short text and beautiful meaningful illustrations.
prompts.frequency_corrected: Make only one precise correction to this infographic. This is a TIME-SEQUENCE story, all stage connectors must point left to right. In BOTH colored rows, the horizontal arrow BETWEEN THE MIRROR and the SECOND AOM currently points LEFT. REVERSE THESE TWO ARROWHEADS to point RIGHT, from mirror toward the second AOM. Keep every other label, drawing, equation, color, position, footnote, and layout identical. The mirror labeled "反射返回" is a chronological stage icon, not a geometric ray diagram. All stage transition arrows must now read left to right. Do not add or remove anything else.
prompts.cat_eye: Use case: scientific-educational. NEW landscape 3:2 Chinese infographic. Image 1 is STYLE ONLY: white background, excellent navy Chinese typography, beautiful translucent glass optics with metallic mounts, pale blue section header, simple precise colorful ray arrows. Title "猫眼：把扫角变成平移". Subtitle "不同 RF 频率，沿各自主光线返回". Main central drawing is an EXACT SIDE-VIEW optical ray diagram, not perspective. A small blue AOM at left with a single fixed exit point O. The optical axis is a grey horizontal dotted line through O. A positive blue glass lens in center with its CENTER on that dotted axis. A VERTICAL silver flat mirror at right. Three colored outgoing chief rays (green low RF, blue center RF, orange high RF) all start at SAME point O, slope upward with three different positive slopes, hit different heights on UPPER HALF of lens. AFTER lens all three rays must run EXACTLY HORIZONTAL, mutually PARALLEL, to the mirror. The mirror is normal to those rays. Draw small right arrowheads for outward rays and left arrowheads just adjacent to the exact SAME colored paths to indicate retracing. DO NOT draw downward returning rays or crossing rays. Lens height sufficient to cover all ray heights and clearly centered on optical axis. Labels above components "AOM", "透镜 L", "反射镜 M"; labels next to rays at mirror "低 RF", "中心 RF", "高 RF". Two accurate dimension spans: FROM exit point O TO lens center "≈ fL", lens center TO mirror "≈ fL". Under main diagram three small illustrated cards in one row, numbered 1 2 3: "扫频改变衍射角", "透镜把扫角转成平移", "镜面回射，再次衍射补偿". Cards contain tiny representative crystal, lens-with-parallel-rays, mirror-with-return-arrow icons. Bottom centered formula "h ≈ fL · θ". Footer "只画主光线，不代表整个光束处处准直；示意图不按比例". No extra graphs, no fake data, no glow obscuring rays.
prompts.polarization:
Use case: scientific-educational. NEW landscape 3:2 Chinese infographic, reference image STYLE ONLY. Use same premium optics illustration style with translucent purple waveplate, silver mirror, blue PBS cube, subtle shadows, white background, navy Chinese typography, pastel blue/green/orange cards. Title "偏振分光：让回程光走向输出口". Subtitle "同一片 QWP 往返，返回线偏振与输入正交".
Main teaching sequence five generous cards arranged LEFT TO RIGHT, all connecting arrows point RIGHT because these are chronological states, not a spatial optical layout:
1 "入射线偏振": circular transverse-view frame with BLUE horizontal double-headed electric-field vector; label "水平".
2 "第一次通过 QWP": purple thin waveplate icon with fast-axis diagonal marker and "45°"; circular transverse frame with a blue CIRCLE field trajectory; label "圆偏振".
3 "镜面反射": polished silver mirror icon and small return-arrow; circular transverse frame with a CIRCLE trajectory; label "返回".
4 "第二次通过 QWP": same purple waveplate icon, circular transverse frame with ORANGE VERTICAL double-headed field vector; label "正交线偏振".
5 "PBS 分离": blue PBS cube with incoming orange horizontal ray from right and reflected orange ray DOWN through output; exact label "输出".
All electric-field vectors are clearly in their OWN transverse-view frames, not arrows indicating light propagation. Two bottom explanation cards: "QWP 快轴与入射线偏振约成 45°" and "往返净效应：线偏振转过 90°". Footer exact text "需确认 AOM 支持所需偏振；不标圆偏振左右手性，避免观察方向歧义". No unexplained extra optics. Short crisp accurate text. Spacious polished visual hierarchy, not a dense wall of text.
prompts.workflow:
Use case: scientific-educational. NEW portrait-leaning 4:3 Chinese illustrated flowchart for an AOM double-pass optics article. Reference is STYLE ONLY: premium glass-and-metal optical component illustration, white background, navy Chinese typography, refined pastel section cards, strong readable arrows. Title "AOM 双程调试路线图". Subtitle "先单程，再回射；先自由空间，再光纤". Main body EXACTLY SIX clearly numbered steps in a TWO COLUMN, THREE ROW layout with a continuous snake route: 1 top-left → 2 top-right → 3 middle-right → 4 middle-left → 5 bottom-left → 6 bottom-right. Arrows connect only these consecutive cards; no extra flow arrows. Each step has an expressive miniature apparatus illustration and short exact text:
1 "确定目标" with frequency dial / RF source icon; smaller "波长 · 频移符号 · 扫频范围".
2 "调好第一程" with a blue AOM and one diffracted laser ray entering power meter; smaller "偏振 · Bragg 角 · 衍射效率".
3 "建立猫眼回射" with lens and VERTICAL flat mirror and outbound/return rays; smaller "透镜位置 · 镜距 · 两点重合".
4 "分离双程输出" with purple QWP and PBS cube giving downward output; smaller "确认两程偏振与目标衍射级".
5 "扫描 RF 检查" with two camera sensor screens each with one spot plus RF dial; smaller "功率 · 近场位置 · 远场指向".
6 "耦合光纤并验收" with fiber coupler, optical fiber, power-meter icon; smaller "拍频 · 耦合效率 · 消光 · 时序".
Footer short dark-blue summary band: "保存热稳定后的曲线、光斑与功率基线". Use robust large Chinese text, visible numbered circles, substantial spacing; diagrams expressive but not decorative; no fabricated quantitative data, no logos or watermark.
